definitions.explanation: In baseball, a batter's advance to first base after the pitcher throws four balls.

examples.japanese: {四球|しきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
{先頭打者|せんとうだしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{四球|しきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えた→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。

{四球|しきゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧ランナーが、⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{打者|だしゃ}→打者：06564_dasha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ヒット→ヒット：11161_hitto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ホーム⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}った→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: The runner who reached on a walk came home on the next batter's hit.

notes:
The official scoring term; in conversation and broadcasts フォアボール ("four ball," a made-in-Japan term) is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {四球|しきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to draw a walk (the batter)
- {四球|しきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧ / ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to issue a walk (the pitcher)
- {四死球|ししきゅう}: walks and hit-by-pitches together

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {死球|しきゅう} / デッドボール: hit by pitch — also puts the batter on first; note the same reading
